# track3r-os

> Community operating system for the Polyend Tracker hardware. Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by Polyend. This is the user manual, one chapter per screen; read the chapter of the screen you are asked about.

Key notation: keys are written in code style, for example `Shift` + `F3` or hold `Instr`; `F1` to `F8` are the soft keys under the screen. If a thing is not in the manual, it is not known: say so.

## Reference

- [Full manual](llms-full.txt): every chapter in one file, for loading whole into a context window

## Chapters

- [Installing track3r-os](install.md): installing an update, what is verified, and going back to the official firmware
- [Getting started](getting_started.md): what the OS is, the card, first boot, the keys and the screen layout
- [The panel](panel.md): Use this page to find a key on the unit and to see what it does.
- [Song](song.md): Use Song to arrange patterns in time.
- [Mixer](mixer.md): track levels, mute and solo, naming a track, the master page
- [Perform](perform.md): the three scenes and the live effects
- [Perform: the DJ page](perform_dj.md): Use the DJ page to play a set from one pattern after another: drums on A and a melody on B, a filter sweep into the next pattern, a stutt...
- [Sample load](sample_load.md): Use Sample load to put a sound file from the card into an instrument.
- [Sample edit](sample_edit.md): Use Sample edit to change a loaded sample: crop, normalize, reverse, fade, change its volume, remove its DC offset, filter it, compress i...
- [Wave and Chop](wave.md): Use Wave to see how a sample plays: its mode and the part of it that sounds.
- [Record](record.md): Use Record to capture sound into a sample, or to build a loop over the pattern.
- [File](file.md): Use the File screen to work with projects on the card.
- [USB disk](usb_disk.md): Use it to copy samples, modules and projects to and from the card without taking it out of the unit.
- [Modules](modules.md): installing .tmod modules from the card and the bundled apps
- [TB-303, FM and Chip: new parameters](module-sounds.md): the new parameters of the TB-303 (MODS page), FM (16 algorithms, Detune) and Chip (learnable wave and duty)
- [Step FX on module instruments](module-instrument-fx.md): which step FX a module instrument obeys
- [Insert effects: eleven effects for one track](insert_effects.md): the Fold, Env Filter, Phaser and Comp track inserts: what each does and its settings
- [Config](config.md): Use the Config screen to change the unit's settings.
- [Computer tools](computer_tools.md): the USB console on a computer: connect, screenshots, firmware path, diagnostics, key injection
- [Glossary](glossary.md): every term of the manual, one entry each
- [Cheat sheet](cheat_sheet.md): The keys on one page.
- [Export](export.md): Export writes what the unit plays to files on the card, in the folder Export/<PROJECT>.
- [Effects in the pattern](fx.md): Use a step effect when one note needs its own treatment and a new instrument would be too much.
- [Input test](input_test.md): Use Input test to check that every key and pad of your unit answers, and how fast.
- [Instrument](instrument.md): Use Instrument to set how an instrument sounds and plays.
- [App pages](module_app.md): Use this page to find your way around any app.
- [Pattern](pattern.md): Use Pattern to write the notes of the current pattern, live or one step at a time, and to copy, delete and undo parts of it.
- [Fill and tools](pattern_tools.md): Use FILL to lay down a rhythm, a fade or a run of random notes in one go, then play with the result.
- [Quick start](quick_start.md): This page is for owners who know the official firmware, and it shows what is different in track3r-os in about five minutes.

## Optional

- [Manual index](index.md): the chapter list and how the manual is written
